extracted.name: Tommy's margarita
extracted.description: Tommy’s margarita - a twist on the classic margarita cocktail but uses agave syrup instead of triple sec. You could use sugar syrup if you can’t get hold of agave
ingredient_lines: A few handfuls of ice cubes
1 lime wedge or wheel to serve
instruction_lines: Fill a cocktail shaker with a handful of ice cubes and add the ingredients except the lime wedge. Shake well until the outside of the shaker feels cold. Strain into a tumbler filled with ice and serve with a lime wedge or wheel to garnish if you like.
